pagedata.pyBrowseSQL: SELECT b.claimno AS "CaseID", b.nopolis AS "NoKTP", b.qqname AS "ClaimID", b.picteknik AS "Conveyance", b.businessname AS "ClaimNo", C.OCCUPATION as "TreatyName", b.leader_member AS "UserTeknisEmail", CASE WHEN b.grouppanel in ('003','009') THEN (select occupationid from pooldata.t_anekalist where nopolis=b.nopolis and prodke=b.prodke and indexobject=a.objectid and rownum=1) WHEN b.grouppanel='006' THEN (SELECT cc.OccupationCode FROM pooldata.t_propertylist z, JSON_TABLE (z.OCCUPATIONLIST, '$' COLUMNS (NESTED PATH '$.OccupationList[*]' COLUMNS (OccupationCode varchar2 path '$.OccupationCode'))) cc WHERE z.nopolis=b.nopolis and z.INDEXOBJECT=a.objectid and z.prodke=b.prodke and rownum='1') ELSE (select goodsid from pooldata.t_cargolist where nopolis=b.nopolis and prodke=b.prodke and goodsid=a.objectid and rownum='1') END AS "UserTeknis", CASE WHEN b.grouppanel in ('003','009') THEN (select occupationname from pooldata.t_anekalist where nopolis=b.nopolis and prodke=b.prodke and indexobject=a.objectid and rownum=1) WHEN b.grouppanel='006' THEN (SELECT dd.OccupationName FROM pooldata.t_propertylist x, JSON_TABLE (x.OCCUPATIONLIST, '$' COLUMNS (NESTED PATH '$.OccupationList[*]' COLUMNS (OccupationName varchar2 path '$.OccupationName'))) dd WHERE x.nopolis=b.nopolis and x.INDEXOBJECT=a.objectid and x.prodke=b.prodke and rownum='1') ELSE (select goodsname from pooldata.t_cargolist where nopolis=b.nopolis and prodke=b.prodke and goodsid=a.objectid and rownum='1') END AS "UserName", to_char(c.begindate,'rrrr') as "Remark", to_char(c.begindate,'dd/mm/yyyy') as "RCV_ID", to_char(c.enddate,'dd/mm/yyyy') as "RW", to_char(b.dateofloss,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "CountryID", to_char(b.registerdate,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "Country", to_char(a.analyst_tfkomitedate,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "Email", to_char(A.ACCEPTANCE_DATECOMITEE,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "District", to_char(a.tglakseptasi,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "AlasanKlaim", (SELECT CURRENCY FROM POOLDATA.CURRENCY WHERE ID = A.CURRENCY) AS "NPWP", (SELECT SUM (ESTIMATIONVALUE) FROM POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_ESTIMASI WHERE claimid = a.claimid AND estimationtype = '1' AND kursid = a.currency) AS "ProdKe", a.noakseptasi AS "DistrictID", a.ASM_SHARE AS "ASMShare", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE AS "KomiteStatus", a.GROSSVALUE AS "Currency", CASE WHEN ASM_SHARE = 100 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS "Status", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_BPPDAN AS "LossCoverage", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_FAC_OUT AS "LokasiSurveyor", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_QS_RI AS "IsTransferPIC", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_FSPL as "AnaylstRemarks", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_PSRSPL as "AnalystDoctorRemaks", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_PSPLNSRI AS "NIK", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_PSRQS_RI as "BranchID", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_FESPL AS "IsAnalisTransfer", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_FAC_OBL as "BranchName", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_FACOBSRB as "BusinessID", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_FACOBINDT as "CASEDB", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_ER1 as "CauseOfLoss", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_ER2 as "CauseOfLossID", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_PSS AS "City", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_PRGBI AS "CityID", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_PFRA AS "ClientID", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_XL AS "ClientName" FROM pooldata.t_claim_adjustment a, pooldata.t_claim_pnc b, pooldata.pega_dashboardpnc c, datapega.pc_asm_fw_gcnmfw_work d WHERE a.noakseptasi IS NOT NULL AND a.paymenttype IN ('1', '2') AND a.claimid = b.claimid AND b.claimno = c.noklaim AND b.claimid=d.pzinskey AND (d.pystatuswork NOT IN ('Resolved-Completed', 'Resolved-Rejected') OR d.ISPENDINGCLOSE ='true') AND b.branchname != 'ASNET' AND b.grouppanel IN ('003', '004', '006', '009') AND b.businesscode NOT IN ('10145', '10168', '10165', '10164', '10053', '10075', '10126', '10011', '10077', '10007') {ASIS:TempLaporan.UserName}
